taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-09 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-09
Curve type: HA-type (file label "AA-type" appears to be a transcription error — resistivities 975.4 > 552.4 < 730.5 < 1710.8 ohm-m follow an H-A sequence, not AA)
Aquifer depth: 1.86 – 24.59 m (low-resistivity layer 2, 552.4 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target the screened interval within 1.86–24.59 m, corresponding to the conductive layer interpreted as the water-bearing zone; confirm the curve-type discrepancy with the interpreting geophysicist before finalizing casing/screen design.
